text: C. Cusack, rider of Premier View, trained by Henry de Bromhead, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his saddle slipped.

C.D. Hayes, rider of Matriarchal, trained by Josh Halley, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount was carried right from a furlong and a half down. The Raceday Stewards reviewed the video footage and were satisfied that no further action was warranted.
N.M. Crosse, rider of Invincible Irish, trained by Daniel McLoughlin, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount hung right.
The Irish Horseracing Regulatory Board Veterinary Officer examined Sapphire Sun, trained by J.P. Murtagh, at the request of the Raceday Stewards and reported the animal to be post race normal.

L.F. Roche, rider of Gonirianbotharleat, trained by Miss Jennifer Anne Lynch, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount had blood at the nostrils post race. This was subsequently confirmed by an IHRB Veterinary Officer.
P. McGettigan, rider of One Cool Bear, trained by Adrian McGuinness, reported to the Stewards' Secretaries that he took a precautionary check two furlongs down.

text: J. Kearney, rider of Alissam, trained by Stephen Thorne, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount was keen early.
The Irish Horseracing Regulatory Board Veterinary Officer examined Sovereign Jazz, trained by Noel Meade, at the request of the Raceday Stewards and reported the animal to be post race normal.
J.S. Dalton, rider of Stable Lane, trained by Rodger Sweeney, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount hung right in the straight.
A.S. Grant, rider of Usuario Amigo (GB), trained by Richard John O'Brien, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount hung left throughout.
Sadhbh Tormey, rider of Suerte, trained by Ms. Sheila Lavery, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that her mount lugged right in the straight.
R.M Mulligan, rider of Lady Crossing, trained by William J. Fitzpatrick, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount fly leaped leaving the stalls.
P. McGettigan, rider of Bull Shark, trained by Robson De Aguiar, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his stirrup broke shortly after leaving the stalls.
